settings.question_1: How fast will I see results?
settings.answer_1: Most people feel increased energy within 1-3 days. Visible fat loss typically starts around week 2-3, with dramatic results by day 31. Results vary based on diet, exercise, and individual metabolism.
settings.question_2: Will this make me jittery or anxious?
settings.answer_2: No! L-Carnitine contains zero caffeine or stimulants. It creates clean energy by burning your stored fat, not by stimulating your nervous system. You'll feel energized and focused without any jitters or crash.
settings.answer_3: Simply take 1 tablespoon (15ml) on an empty stomach, preferably 30 minutes before your first meal or workout. Each bottle contains 31 servings - a full month supply. Mix with water or take it straight.
settings.question_4: Is this safe for long term use?
settings.answer_4: Yes! L-Carnitine is a naturally occurring amino acid already present in your body. It's safe for daily, long-term use.
settings.question_5: Can I take this with other supplements?
settings.answer_5: Yes! L-Carnitine works great on its own or stacked with protein, creatine, or vitamins. It's stimulant-free, so it won't interfere with pre-workouts. As always, consult your doctor if you have concerns.
settings.question_6: What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer_6: We offer a 90-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied, contact us for a full refund - even if the bottles are empty. No questions asked.
